name: FactSet Research Systems Inc.

owner_fcf_base: FY25 owner FCF = reported FCF $617.5M - 100% SBC ($61.2M) = $556.3M ($M). Per diluted share (37.06M) = $15.01. Forward FY26 owner FCF ~$595M (+7%) used to anchor the multiple normalization.

conservador.note: AI/LLM disruption bites moderately: g1 5.0%, phase2 declining 4.5%->2.5%, gt 2.5%, WACC 9.7%. Pessimistic-but-not-apocalyptic: ASV growth halves vs history, margins stay compressed ~220bps. Lands roughly at current price.

base.note: Proven 29-yr compounder continues mid-single/high-single digit: g1 7.0%, phase2 6.0%->3.0%, gt 3.0%, WACC 9.7%. ASV +6-7%, margins stabilize as AI investment matures into product.

optimista.note: FactSet monetizes AI (GenAI/Pitch Creator, workflow) and re-accelerates: g1 9.0%, phase2 7.5%->3.5%, gt 3.5%, WACC 9.7%.

multiple_metric: fwd P/E on FY26 adjusted diluted EPS
multiple_rationale: 5y avg fwd P/E ~29.6x reflects the pre-derating premium era. Apply a deliberate ~33% haircut to 20x for genuine (not purely cyclical) factors: structural AI/LLM disruption risk to the financial-data-terminal model and real margin compression (~220-230bps GAAP/adj op margin in Q2 FY26 from AI investment). 20x is still a quality premium consistent with a 29-consecutive-year ASV-growth franchise (ROIC ~17.7%, FCF margin ~27%, low SBC ~2.6% of revenue) where the AI thesis remains a risk, not a realized impairment - revenue still +7%, EPS adj still growing, guidance raised at Q2. iv_multiple = 20.0 x FY26 adj EPS midpoint $17.50 = $350.
structural_change: MODERATE/MIXED. Real but not yet impairing: (1) AI/LLM narrative threatens the data-terminal model - the core market fear driving the ~52% drop from 52w high and ~55% from ATH; (2) genuine margin compression of ~220-230bps as FactSet invests in AI capabilities. Offsetting: fundamentals are NOT deteriorating - revenue +7.1% YoY in Q2 FY26, organic ASV +6.7%, adj EPS still growing, FY26 guidance RAISED. Verdict: this is predominantly a de-rating/fear event with a moderate genuine structural overhang, not a collapse in the business. Justifies a real multiple haircut (29.6x->20x) but not an apocalyptic one.
